# Copilot instructions for this repository

Repository snapshot
- This repo is a minimal static site: `index.html` (markup) and `bento.css` (single stylesheet).
- No build system, package manifest, or tests were found in the workspace root.

High-level objective for an agent
- Make safe, minimal changes to the static site. Prefer editing `bento.css` for visual/CSS fixes and `index.html` for content/structure.
- Avoid adding large toolchains or dependencies unless explicitly requested by a human.

What to know about structure and patterns
- Files of interest:
  - `index.html` — single-page HTML entry. Modifications should preserve semantic structure and any inline anchors/IDs.
  - `bento.css` — single global stylesheet. Conventions in this file are authoritative for layout and theming.
- Expect a single-author, hand-crafted CSS approach rather than a component library or CSS-in-JS. Scope CSS changes narrowly to avoid breaking unrelated styles.

Developer workflows (discoverable)
- Local development: open `index.html` in a browser (no server required). On Windows PowerShell, a convenient preview command is:
  - `Start-Process index.html`
- There are no test, build, or lint commands in the repository. Do not assume CI or formatting tools unless the user adds them.

Interaction and pull request behavior
- Keep changes focused and small. For visual changes, include a short note explaining what page/viewport was checked.
- When editing CSS, include before/after screenshots in the PR description if the change affects layout noticeably.

Examples and small recipes
- Add a utility class to `bento.css`:
  - Use a clear, short name (e.g., `.u-hidden { display:none !important; }`) and add a one-line comment describing intent.
- Modify page content in `index.html`:
  - Preserve the root structure; add new sections below existing semantic containers and match existing markup style.

When unsure, ask the human
- If a change requires a new build tool, test framework, or external dependency — stop and ask. Clearly state the reasons, alternatives, and risk (e.g., introduces Node tooling, CI changes).

Files to reference when making decisions
- `index.html` — page structure and content
- `bento.css` — global styles, naming patterns, and layout rules

Merge guidance (if this file existed previously)
- If `.github/copilot-instructions.md` already contains human-provided rules, merge conservatively: preserve explicit author instructions and only add repository-specific clarifications.

Contact & feedback
- After making edits, ask the repository owner for visual confirmation and any deployment steps (if they want the changes published).

If anything in this file seems stale or incomplete, request the missing context explicitly (local preview steps, expected viewports, or any branch/CI rules).
